capabilities_done: as-shot neutral read by each vendor decoder (VendorColour.as_shot_neutral, DNG AsShotNeutral convention G = 1): CR3 Canon ColorData WB_RGGBLevelsAsShot by ColorData version (16-19 word 71, 32/33 word 85, 34/48/64-66 word 105; greens must agree within 10 %), NEF maker note 0x000C WB_RBLevels, RAF raw IFD 0xF00E WB_GRBLevels, ORF maker note 0x1017/0x1018 (first value / 256), RW2 0x0024-0x0026 WB_RGBLevels; CR2, ARW and NEF bodies with only the encrypted 0x0097 ColorBalance (D70s, D1H) read none

colour routes (DngRaw.colour_route, crate::camera_colour): (1) file_matrix: Olympus maker note 0x1011 (nine signed SHORTs, every row must sum to 256 within 1 %) read as white-balanced camera -> linear sRGB D65 -> ForwardMatrix = SRGB_TO_XYZ_D50 . M, ColorMatrix = diag(as-shot neutral) . inverse(Bradford(D50->D65) . FM), one D65 calibration, assumption named (file_matrix_white_assumed_d65); (2) spectral_table: ColorMatrix1/2 + ForwardMatrix1/2 for illuminant A and D65, 52 models fitted by tools/camera-matrix-table.py to rawtoaces-data measured spectral sensitivities, lookup by make (rawtoaces make aliases, else first word) and model (leading make word stripped), then rawtoaces-data model aliases (e.g. Z 6_2 -> Z f); (3) none: missing_colour_data kept

tools/camera-matrix-table.py (stdlib Python, data in / Rust out): CIE A by formula, D65 from the CIE daylight basis (rawtoaces define.h) at 6504 K, 190 rawtoaces training reflectances, CIE 1931 CMF from rawtoaces-data; per illuminant a white-preserving least-squares 3x3 (closed form, row-wise Lagrange) for ForwardMatrix (Bradford to D50) and ColorMatrix (diag(camera response to L) . inverse(unadapted fit), peak response 1); fit quality per entry (D65 forward mean/max CIE76; R6 1.94/8.70); refuses a non-Apache data file
